g.text: RV32 multicore system architecture - CppHDL native simulation and generated SystemVerilog

svg.text: CLINT timer/software IRQ + PLIC external IRQ
reset / boot PC / hart ID / DTB

g.text: masked writes - cross-line reads - dirty writeback
peer L1 invalidation + DMA line invalidation
Default configuration: RV32IMAC + Zicsr, Sv32 MMU/TLB, private I/D L1, shared 64 KiB L2.
CPU_CLK_MULTIPLIER=2; CDC payloads use acknowledged toggle mailboxes and two-flop synchronizers.
